name: Grand Regent Antton
title: Grand Regent Antton
heroSub: Pansy Violet Cubic Zirconia, brother of Nightshade Violet Diamond and Grand Regent Reina, and host of his own game show.
facts: Same planet as Nightshade Violet Diamond
personality: Antton is a showman through and through. Put a camera or a mic in front of him and he's a completely different gem. He's got a big toothy grin and a mischievous streak, and you can never quite tell what he's planning next. He loves getting a reaction out of people and talks to everyone like they're on air, even when nobody's watching.
Under all the theatrics, he's loyal to his family above everything else. If Reina or Nightshade ever needed him, the act would drop on the spot.
likes: Catching contestants off guard with a twist
Staying connected with his siblings through his earpiece

abilities.name: Umbrakinesis
abilities.label: Sub-Domain: Darkness
desc: Antton can create, control, and shape darkness, not just as the absence of light, but as a thick, liquid-like force he can bend however he wants.

passives.name: Blind Spot Sense
passives.text: Antton always knows where he would go unseen in any room, crowd, or battlefield. His first attack from Behind or from hiding has advantage. While he's in the party, darkness doesn't slow the Star Gauge.

spells.name: Shadowportation
spells.text: Antton and up to 2 allies sink into the shadows and come back up Near, Far, or Behind anyone, like a cut in production.

spells.name: Star Barrage
spells.text: A spinning carousel of stars made of darkness sweeps across the enemy side. Every enemy resists with SPD. Those who fail take 4d4 damage, and those who pass take half.

spells.name: Special Guests
spells.text: Antton calls in up to 2 gems who are under contract with him. They fight on his side using their own stats, act on his turn, and stay until they're defeated or spared.

spells.name: Constrain
spells.text: Antton smothers the light of every enemy gem. For 3 turns, the enemy party gains 2 fewer Star Gauge marks each round. He can't use his other Umbrakinesis spells while it lasts.

outside.name: Shadow Contract
outside.text: Antton writes a contract out of his shadows. Once it's signed, it turns into shadow smoke that enters the signer's gem or body, and they have to follow its rules.

outside.name: Gacha Ball
outside.text: Antton traps a target inside an extremely durable Gacha Ball made of darkness.

art.alt: Antton, a grinning gem with messy gray hair over his eyes, a purple shirt with a gold HOLO pin and an ON AIR sign, a gold tie, suspenders, holding a gold microphone and reaching out
